categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes address freshness checks in AddrMan (src/addrman.cpp) and carries the P2P area label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a logic bug where AddrMan's time penalty caused identical announcements relayed across multiple peers to artificially inflate an address's multiplicity in the new table up to 8. The author notes this is a small logic bug fix that does not impact adversarial scenarios, making it a worthwhile but deferrable improvement.
